MATHEMATICS — TERMLY EXAM #18
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Solve for x: x + 8 = 16. (1 mark)
   A. 8
   B. 16
   C. 9
   D. 8

2. Which fraction is equivalent to 6/8? (1 mark)
   A. 1/4
   B. 3/4
   C. 1/2
   D. 2/3

3. What is 4 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 11
   B. 28
   C. 29
   D. 3

4. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 24
   C. 36
   D. 42

5. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 90
   B. 18
   C. 36
   D. 81

6. What is 1/4 as a decimal? (1 mark)
   A. 2.5
   B. 0.025
   C. 0.25
   D. 0.205

7. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 25
   C. 10
   D. 26

8. Volume of a cube of side 3 cm is: (1 mark)
   A. 27 cm³
   B. 9 cm³
   C. 18 cm³
   D. 12 cm³

9. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 156
   C. 48
   D. 144

10. What is 8 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 11
   B. 25
   C. 24
   D. 5

11. In the number 3143, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 4
   C. 40
   D. 400

12. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 82
   C. 9
   D. 81

13. In the number 3543, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 10
   C. 400
   D. 40

14. What is 8 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 49
   B. 14
   C. 48
   D. 2

15. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 9 cm and 12 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 15
   B. 17
   C. 3
   D. 21

16. What is 8 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 32
   B. 4
   C. 12
   D. 33

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 50 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

18. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

19. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

20. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 65 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

21. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 70 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

22. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 75 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
